name: 4-Across: ball to 5
subtitle: Press break, first option
goal: Beat the press with passes, not dribbles. Catch it and look up.
options: Inbound: 5 first, then 3, then 1. After the catch: sideline, middle, long, or back to 4.

steps.note: 4 fakes a pass to the middle, then hits 5.
On the catch: 1 angle-cuts to the sideline at half court, 2 angle-cuts to the center circle, 3 goes long to the basket, and 4 steps in behind as the safety.
5 looks up the floor and takes whoever is open: 1 on the sideline, 2 in the middle, 3 long, or 4 behind.
